identity.summary: An unsigned process creates a scheduled task by writing to the Windows Task Scheduler directory, which triggers a Cortex alert. The attack involves creating a malicious task file via a benign-looking
identity.description: An unsigned process creates a scheduled task by writing to the Windows Task Scheduler directory, which triggers a Cortex alert. The attack involves creating a malicious task file via a benign-looking process, and the detection is based on file access patterns and process behavior.

payload.code:
powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path C:\Windows\Tasks\ -Force"
$taskContent = '<Task><Settings><DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>false</DisallowStartIfOnBatteries></Settings></Task>'
Set-Content -Path C:\Windows\Tasks\malicious_task.xml -Value $taskContent
$command = 'C:\Windows\System32\schtasks.exe /create /xml C:\Windows\Tasks\malicious_task.xml /tn "MaliciousTask"'
Invoke-Expression $command

expected_artifacts.description: Scheduled task XML file written to Windows Tasks directory
Process creating the scheduled task file
Schtasks.exe execution to register the task

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unsigned Process Creates Scheduled Task
biocs.description: Detects when an unsigned process creates a scheduled task via file access to the Windows Tasks directory
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path = 'C:\\Windows\\Tasks\\malicious_task.xml'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'signed_process.exe'

abiocs.name: Unsigned Process Accesses Windows Tasks Directory
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where an unsigned process accesses the Windows Tasks directory to create a scheduled task
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE_ACCESS
| filter action_file_path = 'C:\\Windows\\Tasks\\'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'signed_process.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
abiocs.causality_anchor: process creates file in Windows Tasks directory

xql_queries.name: Scheduled Task Creation via File Access
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE_ACCESS
| filter action_file_path = 'C:\\Windows\\Tasks\\'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'signed_process.exe'
| comp count() as cnt by action_process_image_name, action_file_path
| comp count() as cnt by
